permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The Permittee shall allow any duly authorized agent of the Illinois EPA, upon the presentation of credentials, at reasonable times:
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit shows 'Application No.: 07030009' and 'I.D. No.: 043120AAU'. Used Application No. as permitNumber due to absence of an explicit 'Permit No.'; recorded 'I.D. No.' as stateFacilityID. Expiration date not explicitly stated; Condition 1 states: 'This permit shall expire 180 days after the Illinois EPA sends a written request for the renewal of this permit.' Facility name and address taken from the permit header section.

generatorSets.extractionNotes: Capacity and HP from: 'three 2,000 kW (two (2) 2,876-HP and one (1) 2,937-HP) #2 fuel oil fired emergency generators'; unit specifically referenced as 'The new 2,000 kW (2,937 HP) generator set (Generator 3)'. NSPS Subpart IIII applicability and hour meter requirement from Condition 3 (40 CFR 60.4209(a)). Fuel limited by Condition 5.c: 'Diesel fuel (Number 2 fuel oil) shall be the only fuel fired in the diesel generators.' Fuel supplier certifications required per Condition 11.b.ii. Operating hours limit per Condition 4: 'Each diesel generator set runtime shall not exceed 500 hours/year.' Emission calculations for SO2 used 0.05% sulfur for Generator 3 (Condition 5.b); not an explicit fuel sulfur specification, so fuelSulfurContentPct left null.

Grouped as 'Generators 1 and 2' per Condition 5.a. Capacity and HP from the permit header: 'two (2) 2,876-HP' at 2,000 kW each. Operating hours from Condition 4 ('Each diesel generator set runtime shall not exceed 500 hours/year') and Condition 5.a ('Operating Hours: 500 hrs/month, 500 hrs/year'). Fuel limited by Condition 5.c: 'Diesel fuel (Number 2 fuel oil) shall be the only fuel fired in the diesel generators.' Fuel supplier certifications required per Condition 11.b.ii. Emission calculations for these units assumed 0.28% sulfur (Condition 5.a); this is not an explicit fuel sulfur requirement, so fuelSulfurContentPct left null.
